## Overview Harish pillai is a self-driven programmer and independent tech builder who focuses on understanding how systems *actually* work under real-world constraints. His work spans web technologies, Linux-based systems, browser internals, DNS/email infrastructure, cybersecurity fundamentals, and community-driven development.

Rather than relying on abstractions alone, harish pallai prefers hands-on experimentation: breaking systems, observing limitations, and rebuilding lightweight solutions that work even in restricted environments such as browsers, sandboxed iframes, free hosting platforms, or low-resource systems.

## Technical Journey
Harish pillai’s learning approach is strongly practical and exploratory. He actively experiments with:
- Running unconventional or non-native programming languages inside browsers (without WASM)
- Understanding browser sandboxing, security boundaries, and permission models
- Building custom Linux-based systems, live environments, and ISO workflows
- Designing infrastructure using free and open tools while respecting real constraints
- Reverse-engineering platform behavior to find safe, practical workarounds

This mindset shapes all his projects and community contributions.
